summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  **What I did:** Per the high-impact rule, I did a read-only audit only — no edits. I traced the full chain: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` / `modules/auth/handlers.ts` → schema.  **What I found (this is the important part):** The current code, as written, looks correct end-to-end. - Every watchlist route requires a valid session and scopes all reads/writes to `watchlists.user_id` from the session — no anonymous/default-user fallback exists. - `WatchlistPage.tsx`
